name: Church On State
source:
Recently finding himself in as potential candidate to become mayor, Adam Fitzpatrick works to gain the support and influence of a local church. Little does he know, that the church has other plans for him and his married life. And it involves, tits, ass and a whole lot un-holy acts.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/toptierstory/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
亚当·菲茨帕特里克 (Adam Fitzpatrick) 最近发现自己是市长的潜在候选人，他努力争取当地教会的支持和影响力。他几乎不知道教会对他和他的婚姻生活还有其他计划。它涉及乳房、屁股和一大堆不圣洁的行为。

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/toptierstory/about]Patreon[/url]]
